criteria.narrative:
Awarded after instructor review confirmed at least 75% on each required activity: M8A9 (Builds Full-Stack JavaScript and AI).

Award threshold: 75%.

m8a9: Builds Full-Stack JavaScript and AI. Documented how AI was used while building a Node, Express and Postgres project. The assessment reviewed commit-linked usage entries, corrections to AI output, explanations of personal contributions and AI credit in the README.
